title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: clock model, first counted day and slab lengths
content:
## Scope

For every product of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, three structural settings shape how a per-container record counts its days: the clock model, the offset of the first counted day, and the lengths of the charge slabs.

## Settings per product

| Product | Clock model | First counted day (days after the start event) | Slab 1 length | Slab 2 length | Slab 3 length |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | separate | 1 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | separate | 1 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | separate | 1 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | combined | 1 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | combined | 1 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | combined | 1 | 7 | 7 | 14 |

## Meaning of each setting

- **Clock model**: separate means demurrage and detention run on separate clocks, each with its own free days; combined means they run on one merged clock.
- **First counted day**: the number of days after the start event on which a clock's first counted day falls, in whole days.
- **Slab 1 length**: the number of chargeable days billed at slab 1 rates.
- **Slab 2 length**: the number of chargeable days after slab 1 that are billed at slab 2 rates.
- **Slab 3 length**: the number of chargeable days after slab 2 that are billed at slab 3 rates; every later chargeable day is a slab 4 day.

## Slab ranges restated

Reading the three lengths in sequence gives the following ranges of chargeable days.

| Product | Slab 1 | Slab 2 | Slab 3 | Slab 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time, AHL Free Time Extension 3, AHL Free Time Extension 7, AHL Combined Free Time 14, AHL Combined Free Time 21 | days 1 to 5 | days 6 to 10 | days 11 to 20 | day 21 onward |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | days 1 to 7 | days 8 to 14 | days 15 to 28 | day 29 onward |

## Points of judgement

**Q: Under which products do demurrage and detention share one clock?**
A: AHL Combined Free Time 14, AHL Combined Free Time 21 and AHL Contract Free Time 30, whose clock model is combined.

**Q: On which day does counting begin after the start event?**
A: Under every product the first counted day falls 1 day after the start event, that is, on the calendar day following it.

**Q: Under AHL Contract Free Time 30, which slab does the 15th chargeable day fall in?**
A: Slab 3, because slab 1 covers the first 7 chargeable days and slab 2 the next 7.
